name: Convex Contouring with Decision Trees
definition: A table-driven contouring method that produces topologically consistent surfaces with a local convexity property, where the polygonal contour inside each cell encloses a convex negative space.
summary: Convex Contouring is a table-driven isosurface extraction technique that uses pre-computed decision trees to dynamically select triangulations based on edge intersection positions, ensuring topologically consistent surfaces with locally convex negative space.
